<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_INQ_IP" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/inq-ip">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DataRequest" name="Transaction data request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DataTransmission" name="Transmission of data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Rejection" name="Rejection"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_INQ_IP">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_INQ" name="INQ" processRef="Process_INQ"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IP" name="IP" processRef="Process_IP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DataRequest" name="Transaction data request" sourceRef="Task_TransmitRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_IP_Request" messageRef="Msg_DataRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DataTransmission" name="Transmission of data" sourceRef="Task_TransmitData" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAnswer" messageRef="Msg_DataTransmission"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Task_RejectRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAnswer" messageRef="Msg_Rejection"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_INQ" name="INQ" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_INQ" name="Information request needed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TransmitRequest" name="Transmit transaction data request"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAnswer" name="Receive answer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_INQ" name="Answer received"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_INQ" targetRef="Task_TransmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_2" sourceRef="Task_TransmitRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAnswer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAnswer" targetRef="EndEvent_INQ"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IP_Request" name="Request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_IP_Request" messageRef="Msg_DataRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequest" name="Check request"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Outcome_Split" name="Examination outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TransmitData" name="Transmit data" messageRef="Msg_DataTransmission"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RejectRequest" name="Reject request" messageRef="Msg_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Outcome_Join" name="Answer given"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IP" name="Request answered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IP_Request" targetRef="Task_CheckRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_3" name="Request examined positively" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome_Split" targetRef="Task_TransmitData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_4" name="Request rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome_Split" targetRef="Task_RejectRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_5" sourceRef="Task_TransmitData" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_6" sourceRef="Task_RejectRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_7" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_IP"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
